blocks.text: Violation tickets help track, investigate, and resolve policy violations discovered in Asset Exposure Management (AEM). To support different remediation workflows, you can manage violation tickets in several ways, including adding comments and attachments and reviewing the activity tab for ticket history. These actions help you organize the remediation work and keep all related context in one place.

blocks.heading: Adding Comments for a Violation Ticket

blocks.text: You can add comments and view discussions related to a violation ticket. This helps teams collaborate, share updates, document findings, and maintain a record of communication and progress in one place.
To add a comment to a violation ticket:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Assets in the top navigation bar.
In the left-side navigation, click Violation Tickets.
Enter a comment in the field.

blocks.text: You can also add supporting information to a violation ticket comment. This enables the security team to attach evidence related to the policy violation, providing additional context and making the violation easier to review.
Click the Add Attachment icon and add the required attachment.

The Activity tab displays the history of actions performed on the violation ticket. It provides an audit trail of violation ticket activities such as status changes, assignment changes, ticket updates, system-recorded events, who performed each action, and when each action occurred. This helps track the history of the violation ticket and understand how the ticket has been handled over time.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Assets in the top navigation bar.
In the left-side navigation, click Violation Tickets.
